segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב נַחְמָן לְדָרוּ עַבְדֵּיהּ: עַבְדָּא דְּמַפֵּיק לֵיהּ מָרֵיהּ לְחֵירוּת, וְיָהֵיב לֵיהּ כַּסְפָּא וְדַהֲבָא, מַאי בָּעֵי לְמֵימַר לֵיהּ? אֲמַר לֵיהּ: בָּעֵי לְאוֹדוֹיֵי וּלְשַׁבּוֹחֵי, אֲמַר לֵיהּ: פְּטַרְתַּן מִלּוֹמַר ״מָה נִשְׁתַּנָּה״. פָּתַח וְאָמַר ״עֲבָדִים הָיִינוּ״.
segments.en: «Rav Naḥman said to his servant, Daru:» With regard to «a slave who is freed by his master, who gives him gold and silver, what» should «the slave say to him?» Daru «said to him: He must thank and praise» his master. «He said to him:» If so, «you have exempted us from reciting» the questions of: «Why is this» night «different,» as you have stated the essence of the seder night. Rav Naḥman immediately «began to recite: We were slaves.»
